title: Gluing supported perfect detectors across one affine chart
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], equipped with derived localizations for its module sheaves and their open restrictions [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $s$ be a finite affine open cover of $X$ with $|s|\geq 2$. Assume that every quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme $Y$ equipped with such localizations and an affine open cover $t$ with $|t|<|s|$ has the following property: for every closed $S\subseteq Y$ with quasi-compact complement, there exists a perfect quasi-coherent object $P$ [def-pc-perfect-complex] supported on $S$ such that every quasi-coherent object supported on $S$ and orthogonal to all shifts of $P$ is zero. Then, for every closed $T\subseteq X$ with quasi-compact complement, there exists a perfect quasi-coherent object $E$ supported on $T$ such that every quasi-coherent object supported on $T$ and orthogonal to all shifts of $E$ is zero. This is the single affine-chart gluing implication, with its induction hypothesis restricted to strictly smaller covers.

proof.text: Obtain U,V,R,adj,Q with conditional detection after inversion of the open unit from the lifted smaller-cover detector theorem.
Apply the supported Koszul summand theorem to Q and obtain E, perfect and supported on T, with Q a retract and the unit invertible for supported objects orthogonal to E.

For a supported K orthogonal to all shifts of E, its open unit is invertible. Map the retract Q of E through each shift functor. Precomposition with its split projection embeds Hom(Q[n],K) into Hom(E[n],K): precompose equality there by the split inclusion and use inclusion followed by projection equals identity. Thus every Hom(Q[n],K) is subsingleton. Apply conditional detection to conclude K is zero.

proof_origin.note: B2: split into open-lift conditional detection and Koszul unit summand; combine by shifted retract cancellation.

No equivalent statement. For triangulated closure the source has DerivedCategory.homologyProperty_isTriangulated, which additionally needs weak Serre class instances; these are not supplied for the supported quasi-coherent property. Existing KoszulOpenOrthogonality supplies the orthogonality input, not the finite supported perfect object construction. PerfectGenerationOpenInduction concerns all quasi-coherent objects rather than a supported category.

theorem supported_perfect_detector_gluing
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (s : Finset X.affineOpens) (hcover : (⨆ U ∈ s, (U : X.Opens)) = ⊤)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ s.card)
    (ih : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
      [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
      [∀ U : Y.Opens,
        HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
      (t : Finset Y.affineOpens), t.card < s.card →
      (⨆ U ∈ t, (U : Y.Opens)) = ⊤ →
      ∀ (S : Set Y), IsClosed S → IsCompact Sᶜ →
        ∃ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y, Scheme.IsPerfect Y E.obj ∧
          (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : Y), x ∉ S →
            Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) n).obj E.obj).val.presheaf x))) ∧
          ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y,
            (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : Y), x ∉ S →
              Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) n).obj K.obj).val.presheaf x))) →
            (∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton (E.obj⟦n⟧ ⟶ K.obj)) → IsZero K.obj)
    (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTc : IsCompact Tᶜ) :
    ∃ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, Scheme.IsPerfect X E.obj ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj E.obj).val.presheaf x))) ∧
      ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
        (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T →
          Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj K.obj).val.presheaf x))) →
        (∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton (E.obj⟦n⟧ ⟶ K.obj)) → IsZero K.obj
